description: stablenet: attaches to a network that is already up. This declaration composes nothing — it points at an endpoint. GSTABLE_RPC changes the address (the default is stablenet-bp4's node1). The name follows the shape of GSTABLE_BIN because the variable has to say which chain and which thing, or they blur together as chains are added. keysDir and provides are stated here too, since only whoever composed the network knows what it offers.
